title: refactor(Development/AbelianVarietyTheory/Proofs): share SpreadScheme model gluing in SmoothGrpSchemeDescendsToFgSubring
body:
Generalize the finite-type model gluing and compact-open induction in `SchemeDescendsToSubalgebra.lean` over morphism properties `(P Q : MorphismProperty Scheme.{0})`, and reuse `GlobalTheory.SpreadScheme.hasModel_of_affine` at `(@Smooth, @IsSeparated)` in `SmoothGrpSchemeDescendsToFgSubring.lean` instead of duplicating the model-isomorphism and gluing machinery.

Changed declarations in `Development/AbelianVarietyTheory/Proofs/DegenerationProofs/SchemeDescendsToSubalgebra.lean`:
- Generalized over `(P Q : MorphismProperty Scheme.{0})`: `GlobalTheory.SpreadScheme.HasModel`, `GlobalTheory.SpreadScheme.PairModel`, `GlobalTheory.SpreadScheme.PairModel.baseChange`, `GlobalTheory.SpreadScheme.PairModel.baseChange_a₀_p₀`, `GlobalTheory.SpreadScheme.exists_glued`, `GlobalTheory.SpreadScheme.exists_pairModel`, `GlobalTheory.SpreadScheme.hasModel_of_two`
- Replaced `GlobalTheory.SpreadScheme.lfp_of_two` with `GlobalTheory.SpreadScheme.of_two`
- Added `GlobalTheory.SpreadScheme.hasModel_of_affine`

Removed declarations in `Development/AbelianVarietyTheory/Proofs/ModuliProofs/SmoothGrpSchemeDescendsToFgSubring.lean`:
- `GlobalTheory.Spread.eq_isoPullback_hom_comp_bcMap`, `GlobalTheory.Spread.comp_eq_id_of_models`, `GlobalTheory.smooth_models_iso_over_fg_subalgebra`
- `GlobalTheory.SpreadGroup.HasModel`, `GlobalTheory.SpreadGroup.PairModel`, `GlobalTheory.SpreadGroup.isPullback_lift`, `GlobalTheory.SpreadGroup.PairModel.baseChange`, `GlobalTheory.SpreadGroup.PairModel.baseChange_a₀_p₀`, `GlobalTheory.SpreadGroup.smooth_of_two`, `GlobalTheory.SpreadGroup.exists_glued`, `GlobalTheory.SpreadGroup.exists_pairModel`, `GlobalTheory.SpreadGroup.exists_common_level`, `GlobalTheory.SpreadGroup.hasModel_of_two`, `GlobalTheory.SpreadGroup.hasModel_of_isAffine`, `GlobalTheory.SpreadGroup.hasModel`
